About this item

  • Independent Integrated Spring Padding: GTPLAYER gaming chair is equipped with high-quality integrated spring padding that provides optimal comfort and support while gaming and working. This advanced seating technology provides dynamic support and adjusts to your position to ensure long-lasting comfort and reduce fatigue during long gaming sessions.
  • Soft, highly breathable fabric: Keeps you dry when sitting for long periods, reduces sweating and feeling hot, and provides a comfortable skin feel. High-quality fabric is also more durable and less prone to tears or wear that often occur with leather game chairs. The backrest design is complemented by precise and stylish embroidery that gives the chair an elegant and unique look.
  • Ergonomic design: The armrests are synchronously adjustable and adapt to the sitting position to promote an ergonomic posture and maximize comfort. With the adjustable backrest from 90 to 150 degrees and the fold-out footrest, you can customize your seating pleasure.
  • Quality without worries: The SGS certified level 3 gas lift cylinder allows for personal height adjustment, so you don't have to worry about the chair not fitting your height. The soft adjustable head and lumbar cushions provide additional support and improve comfort to reduce fatigue and enhance the gaming experience.
  • Satisfaction Guarantee: GTPLAYER dedicated customer service and quality guarantee offer you worry-free use. The computer gaming chair is easy to assemble with the included parts and tools.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
